title: Treasury coupon announcement (month-end 2Y / 5Y / 7Y note + 2Y FRN reopening sizes, plus three bills)
source: TSY: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov `auctions_query` filtered `announcemt_date:eq:2026-09-17`, fetched direct by this event's own close-out session 2026-09-18 (HTTP 200, 7 rows, 34,314 bytes) — the EXECUTED auction record, not the tentative schedule this entry was originally filed from. No 52-week bill in this batch, matching the original prediction. notes: The missing sibling in an announcement series the calendar already tracks five members of (2026-09-03, 2026-09-10, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-22), and specifically the confirming primary for treasury-2y-frn-2026-09-23, which is `estimate`-dated on a tentative schedule and had no dated event to attach its confirmation to. The four coupon numbers are therefore already in writing (2Y $69B, 5Y $70B, 7Y $44B, FRN reopening $28B = $211B) and the FRN leg is researched in its own ledger — the ONLY live number in this release is the bill leg, and per the 2026-09-05 initial research the obvious read of it is wrong: sb0590 says Treasury `expects to implement reductions to shorter-dated bill auction sizes during the month of September`, but those reductions were executed 2026-08-27 through 09-08 (6-week 95 to 85 to 75, 4-week 110 to 100 to 90, 8-week 100 to 90 to 85, minus $55B across three tenors) and the benchmark 13-/26-week bills held flat through every mid-September announcement in 2023, 2024 and 2025, stepping up only at month-end or in early October. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Structural notes for a later session: this announcement lands the day after the 2026-09-16 FOMC decision, on the final day of the communications blackout, and one day before the 2026-09-18 triple witching, while the 2026-09-17 10-Year TIPS auction prices roughly two hours after it — no intraday attribution to it is defensible. Its three notes plus that TIPS settle on Wednesday 2026-09-30, which is quarter-end, the government-funding-deadline-2026-09-30 date, PCE and the third Q2 GDP estimate.
